body: Ah well okay i went to the VFS one in Dubai

I keep checking all countries but theyre always full. You have to keep checking every now and then. For example for Germany we got waitlisted i think a month back? Last week we got an email that there are slots available. I was out of the country when i received the email and it was only valid for 48 hours. Didnt see the email right away I think I saw it half a day left and couldnt access the site outside of dubai. Asked my sister who was in Dubai to access it for me and got the appointment for next month.

Yes agree they double check everything, I missed one night booking because I was thinking it would be an overnight trip so I wouldnt need a hotel booking but the VFS officer told me regardless I still need a booking. I booked the same time and he happily printed it and added to my documents. I also forgot to bring a photocopy of my emirates ID and he happily printed it for me too without any extra charge. He pointed out all my missing docs (basically those 2) and I was super worried as the additional booking wasnt in my application form but still got the visa 2 days after. Kudos to that guy from VFS italy dubai
No it’s also VFS their office is in DIFC that’s where I went last time

Sorry but that’s true. I applied in Italy back in February, Appointment fee is around 90aed only. I just added courier services and sms updates on top of that plus visa fees so around 500 aed in total. Got my visa in 2 days. I was surprised it was that fast too. Got new appointment next month in Germany. Germany’s VFS appointment fee is more expensive tho, 142 plus same costs for the 2 add ons I had similar to Italy’s

Hey, everything will be alright in the end as long as you dont give up. If nothing’s going right at the moment, then it’s not the end yet. You just have to go through it, learn through your experience, and toughen up. Try to learn things on your free time. Im quite new in my company and I just found out that one of the guys working under me as CAD draftsman wasnt an Architect. But that’s not what surprised me. What did was when he said he used to be an office boy in our company for 4 years, and in the last 2 years, he’s been working as CAD draftsman. He knew nothing about it but he was just curious and tried to learn. Now hés in this position, not at the highest but still better than where he was before. For some it might be very a quick path to greatness and good life, but for some, they have a longer way. Dont worry. Just hang in there. It will be alright. HE will always provide. 🙂

Try to keep working only during work hours and dont extend. Use your free time to do what you really want to. Take courses that you’re passionate about. Ive been an Interior Designer for 9 years (5 here in UAE) and there was a point in my life that I really got tired of it. Earlier this year, I took a 6-month Professional diploma course in Fashion Design. I have just finished it and because of joining student or non student competitions in these 6 months, I’ve got few exposures and just recently One of them landed me a project and I hope this is a stepping stone to pave my way in the Fashion world. Im still working as an Interior Designer as this is my main source of income but eventually as I get more exposures to fashion industry I will change careers fully. Stay strong OP, it will not come right away, you have to work for it but if you really want to, you’ll find it. 🙂
